description: Every url of a site, fast and cheap: its sitemap plus, optionally, the links on the page. Use it BEFORE crawling, to see what is there and decide what is worth reading. 1 credit ($0.002) with `includePage: false` (no browser at all), 1.5 credits ($0.003) with the page. Reference for the oassis API: https://oassis.dev/openapi.json

excludePaths.description: Discard urls whose path contains one of these. Up to twenty. It wins over `includePaths`.

includePage.description: Render the page too, to catch urls the sitemap does not list. `false` uses no browser at all, so it costs less: $0.002 against $0.003.

includePaths.description: Keep only urls whose path contains one of these. Up to twenty.

includeSubdomains.description: Treat subdomains of the same site as part of it.

search.description: Keep only urls containing this text.

name: web_map
